An Indian Village with ZERO Electricity Bill, FREE Cooking Gas & Women Own Every Home?
Sounds like a fairytale? Meet Shelkewadi, Maharashtra!
For 20+ years, Shelkewadi has solved problems that Indian cities still struggle with: LPG dependency, power cuts, water crisis, pollution, and waste, all without crores in budget.
In this episode of Solved In India, we visit this tiny village in Karvir Taluka, Kolhapur, where barely 80 families live. They’ve built a real-life zero-waste, self-sufficient, sustainable village model that every Indian village can copy.
